# `m.indices.bars`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Open, high, low, and close index levels over fixed windows of time.

```python
m.indices.bars(symbols, timespan, *, multiplier=1)
```

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Day Aggregates (flat files) | Minute Aggregates (flat files) | Custom Bars (OHLC) (REST) | Aggregates (Per Minute) (WebSocket) | Aggregates (Per Second) (WebSocket) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Indices Basic | Not included | Not included | End-of-day, All history | Not included | Not included |
| Indices Starter | End-of-day, All history | End-of-day, All history | 15-minute delayed, All history | 15-minute delayed | Not included |
| Indices Advanced | End-of-day, All history | End-of-day, All history | Real-time, All history | Real-time | Real-time |
| Indices Business | End-of-day, All history | End-of-day, All history | Real-time, All history | Real-time | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST: the request's `indicesTicker` parameter; flat files `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under."; WebSocket `sym`: "The symbol representing the given index." | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the bar, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the New York date of `TimestampStart` for an intraday or 1-day bar, and null for a bar that spans more than one date (several days, a week or longer, or an intraday bar that crosses midnight). Joining an intraday row to the same day's daily bar on `Date` attaches values not known until that day ended, and a null `Date` matches another null, so join longer bars on `TimestampEnd`. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `TimestampStart` | Instant | The start of the bar's window, as an Instant. A bar of a day or longer starts at 00:00 New York time of its window's first day (a week's Sunday, a month's, quarter's, or year's 1st), whichever source serves it; each source's own stamp, quoted next, is moved there. From REST `t`: "The Unix millisecond timestamp for the start of the aggregate window."; flat files `window_start`: "The Unix nanosecond timestamp for the start of the aggregate window."; WebSocket `s`: "The start timestamp of this aggregate window in Unix Milliseconds." | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `TimestampEnd` | Instant | The exclusive end of the bar's window, as an Instant: the first instant at which the bar is complete, so an as-of join on it, `aj(t, bars, on=["Symbol", "Timestamp>=TimestampEnd"])`, never attaches a bar that is still open. It is when the window closes, not when Massive published the bar, and Massive may correct a bar later. An intraday bar ends its length after its start; a bar of a day or longer at 00:00 New York time after its window's last day. For indices that end is an hour later, 01:00 New York time, since whether an index day bar covers the New York or the Chicago day is not verified. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Open` | double | The open value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `High` | double | The highest value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Low` | double | The lowest value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Close` | double | The close value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `OfficialOpen` | double | Today's official opening value. | WebSocket |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |

`RawSymbol` holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. A session with `unreadable_symbols=dm.OnError.RAISE` (or `DEEPHAVEN_MASSIVE_UNREADABLE_SYMBOLS=raise`) fails on such a row instead and has no `RawSymbol`; the table shows the default session.
